name: Modoc Community Adult Education (Modoc County Office of Education)
description: Adult Basic Education, GED prep, high school equivalency (HSE), diploma completion, ESL/citizenship, career technical education including CTE-ICEV modules, computer literacy and GED testing. Lassen–Modoc Adult Education Consortium

name: Modoc County Behavioral Health Services
description: Mental health and substance use outpatient services, full-spectrum care, case management, youth and adult support services, medication support, behavioral modification and Spanish-language support.

name: Modoc County Public Health Services
description: WIC, immunizations, family planning, STI/HIV/Hepatitis/TB testing and counseling, STD prevention and education, case management, medication adherence and ADAP support, multi-lingual services, family planning and vital records. Modoc Medical Center

name: Canby Family Practice Clinic (Last Frontier Healthcare District)
description: Medical exams, immunizations, women’s health, family planning, children’s CHDP exams, well child and adult exams, sports, school, DMV/DOT physicals, integrated behavioral health counseling, dental hygiene and preventative care, dental exams and x-rays, dental extractions, and dentures.

name: T.E.A.C.H., Inc. – Modoc County
description: Emergency services including homeless assistance, basic life skills, housing programs, transportation and county-wide inclusive support services.

name: Modoc County Social Services Department (HHSA)
description: Medi-Cal, CalFresh, CalWORKs, General Assistance, Child/Adult Protective Services, including application assistance via BenefitsCal or Dropbox, and In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS).

name: Modoc County Alcohol & Drug Services (AODS)
description: Substance use disorder treatment including co-occurring mental health support, counseling, and outpatient services through Behavioral Health division.

name: Modoc County Food Resources
description: Food assistance for those in need.
